name: Sidereal-Catafalque
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by an orbital debris ring, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.

The terrain around the starship crash site (warship) is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
